name: kiosk
summary: A Node web page with a small server and a JSON file store, in one repo. Checks drive the page in a browser; some bugs show only on the screen, some only in storage.

menu.shown.words: the menu is shown with prices

cart.add.words: adding an item again raises its quantity

cart.total.words: the total shown equals the sum of the lines

order.place.words: placing an order stores what the customer saw

breaks.what: the total shown ignores quantities (the stored total stays right)
tapping Add again leaves the quantity at one
the server stores every line with quantity one
the confirmation shows a number one higher than the stored order
an empty cart is posted to the server, which refuses it with a different message
the page leaves out the last menu item
